title: The Truck with the Elephant Trunk
synopsis: Rex, Gus, and Jack watch an adult crew clean a street-drain basin using a vacuum truck and a huge flexible hose.
continuity_state: Before: The street sweeper has collected grit along the curb, and Ms. Pam has returned all four orange cones to her garage shed. The grated storm inlet near the west farm-road junction still has accumulated mud and leaves below the grate. After: A municipal crew uses a vacuum-cleaning truck at the existing catch basin near Red Door Garage; sediment and water are captured inside its truck tank. The basin has been cleaned, and the truck departs for its next job. The street sweeper and vacuum truck remain distinct vehicles; the drain remains a part of the established road.
